# TemporalRule

A jurisdiction rule value with effective dates, legislative status, and change history

Source: [`v3/common/temporal-rule.json`](../../../v3/common/temporal-rule.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/common/temporal-rule.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` or `boolean` or `string` or `object` | yes | The actual rule value — a number (tax rate, threshold in minor units), boolean (rule applies or not), string (enum value, fraction), or object (complex rule). The consumer must interpret this in context |
| `effectiveFrom` | `string` (date) | yes | The date from which this rule value takes effect. For enacted legislation, this is the commencement date, not the date of royal assent |
| `effectiveUntil` | `string` (date) or `null` | | The date this rule value was or will be superseded. Null means it is currently in effect with no known end date |
| `status` | one of `enacted`, `royal_assent`, `bill_stage`, `consultation`, `announced` | yes | The legislative status of this rule. Only 'enacted' rules are legally binding — all others are prospective |
| `predecessorValue` | `number` or `boolean` or `string` or `object` or `null` | | The previous value of this rule, for computing deltas and understanding the direction of change. Null if this is the first known value |
| `legislativeReference` | `string` | | Citation for the legislation that establishes this rule value. Include act name, section, and year |
| `notes` | `string` | | Free-text commentary on this rule value — transitional provisions, known ambiguities, or political context |
| `jurisdiction` | [Jurisdiction](jurisdiction.md) | | The jurisdiction this temporal rule applies to. Enables different thresholds for different jurisdictions (e.g. UK IHT vs Scottish IHT) |
